objective: Vectorize the mxnet CPU LogSoftmax forward kernel (Softmax<log_softmax_fwd,false,double,float,half_t,int,2>) on RISC-V with RVV 1.0, replacing the un-vectorized 3-pass scalar loop (scalar libm expf ~39.98% + log ~44.27% call-site samples, scalar compare-branch max reduction ~10.01%), and enable the zfhmin/zvfhmin ISA extensions in the build so FP16 output uses native narrowing conversions. Preserve the existing scalar loops and the softmax_fwd path unchanged as fallback.

changes.rationale: The hot function Softmax<log_softmax_fwd,false,double,float,half_t,int,2> is a compiler-generated scalar 3-pass normalization: scalar libm expf (39.98%) and log (44.27%) call sites dominate and the max reduction uses a scalar compare-branch chain (10.01%); hardware and build both expose RVV 1.0 (zve64f/zvl128b) yet the main loops contain no v* instructions (blueprint hotspotEvidence 'RVV Normalization Kernels', confidence HIGH, benefitUpperbound 0.84). Adding a guarded RVV fast path removes the transcendental PLT calls and the scalar reduction chain.
instructions: Add a RISC-V include block guarded by `#if defined(__riscv) && defined(__riscv_v)`: include `<riscv_vector.h>` and define `MXNET_RVV_F16_NARROW` to 1 when `defined(__riscv_zvfh) || defined(__riscv_zvfhmin)`, else 0.

Inside `namespace mxnet { namespace op { namespace mxnet_op {`, after the `log_softmax_fwd` struct and before the `Softmax` template, add an RVV helper block under the same `#if defined(__riscv) && defined(__riscv_v)` guard.

Implement `vexp_f32m1(vfloat32m1_t x, size_t vl)`: a self-contained range-reduced vector exp (do not assume a project vector-math library exists). Compute k = round(x * log2(e)) via `__riscv_vfmul_vf_f32m1` + `__riscv_vfcvt_x_f_v_i32m1` + `__riscv_vfcvt_f_x_v_f32m1`, r = x - k*ln2 with ln2 split high/low, evaluate a degree-5 Horner polynomial Q(r) and exp = 1 + r*Q(r), rebuild 2^k from the IEEE-754 exponent field `((k+127)<<23)` via `__riscv_vsll_vx_i32m1`/`__riscv_vadd_vx_i32m1`/`__riscv_vreinterpret_v_i32m1_f32m1`, clamp finite inputs to [ln(FLT_MIN), 128*ln2] with `__riscv_vfmax_vf_f32m1`/`__riscv_vfmin_vf_f32m1`, and re-inject NaN lanes using `__riscv_vmfne_vv_f32m1_b32` + `__riscv_vmerge_vvm_f32m1` so NaN propagates.

Implement `vstore_as<OType>(OType* out, vfloat32m1_t v, size_t vl)` using `if constexpr`: for `float` store with `__riscv_vse32_v_f32m1`; for `mshadow::half::half_t` narrow with `__riscv_vfncvt_f_f_w_f16m1_f32m1` and store via `__riscv_vreinterpret_v_f16m1_u16m1` + `__riscv_vse16_v_u16m1` under `#if MXNET_RVV_F16_NARROW`.

Implement `log_softmax_fwd_row<OType>(const float* in, OType* out, index_t M)` with three explicit passes preserving the reference semantics: (1) max reduction using `__riscv_vle32_v_f32m1` + `__riscv_vfredmax_vs_f32m1_f32m1` with a scalar seed carried across blocks; (2) `vfsub.vf(x - mmax)` + `vexp_f32m1` + `__riscv_vfredusum_vs_f32m1_f32m1` with a scalar seed; (3) output `(x - mmax) - log(sum)` where `log(sum)` is computed once as a scalar with `std::log(double)` and applied via `__riscv_vfsub_vf_f32m1`, then stored with `vstore_as`. Use `__riscv_vsetvl_e32m1` for fixed-VL main loop plus runtime tail.

Add a compile-time eligibility trait `rvv_log_softmax_fwd_eligible<OP, negate, DType, OType>` that is true only for `std::is_same<OP, log_softmax_fwd>::value && !negate && std::is_same<DType, float>::value && (std::is_same<OType, float>::value || (std::is_same<OType, mshadow::half::half_t>::value && MXNET_RVV_F16_NARROW == 1))`.

In `Softmax(...)`, immediately after `index_t sa = stride[axis];`, add an `if constexpr` dispatch guarded by `#if defined(__riscv) && defined(__riscv_v)`; when eligible and at runtime `length == nullptr && sa == 1 && temperature == DType(1.0)`, run an OpenMP-parallel loop over N rows calling `log_softmax_fwd_row<OType>(in + base, out + base, M)` and `return`. Leave the existing `if (length == nullptr) { ... } else { ... }` scalar bodies and the `softmax_fwd`/`negate` paths completely untouched as fallback.
Do not alter the `Softmax` template signature, `softmax_fwd`, `log_softmax_fwd` struct definitions, `SoftmaxGrad`, or the CUDA section.

changes.rationale: The build's Tag_RISCV_arch is rv64...v1p0...zvl128b with no zfh/zfhmin, while the SG2044 hardware ISA includes zfh/zfhmin and zvfhmin; FP16 output therefore falls back to a software float2half bit-manipulation sequence (~2% samples) instead of native conversions (blueprint hotspotEvidence 'RISC-V ISA Extension-Specific Instruction Substitution', confidence MEDIUM). Enabling the extensions also makes `__riscv_zvfhmin` visible so the new RVV half_t store path compiles to `vfncvt.f.f.v`.
instructions: In the non-MSVC branch, immediately after `set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS "${CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS} ${CMAKE_C_FLAGS}")` (around line 256), add a RISC-V-only block.
Detect RISC-V with `if(CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR MATCHES "riscv64" OR SYSTEM_ARCHITECTURE MATCHES "riscv64")`.
Probe `check_cxx_compiler_flag("-march=rv64gcv_zfhmin_zvfhmin" MXNET_RISCV_ZFHMIN_SUPPORTED)`; when supported append `-march=rv64gcv_zfhmin_zvfhmin` to both `CMAKE_C_FLAGS` and `CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS`.

When the first probe fails, fall back to `check_cxx_compiler_flag("-march=rv64gcv" MXNET_RISCV_GV_SUPPORTED)` and append `-march=rv64gcv` to both flag variables only when supported, leaving non-RISC-V and unsupported toolchains unchanged.
Rely on the existing `include(CheckCXXCompilerFlag)`; do not add unrelated formatting or flags.

expectedDiffSummary: src/operator/nn/softmax-inl.h gains an `#if defined(__riscv) && defined(__riscv_v)` block with <riscv_vector.h>, an MXNET_RVV_F16_NARROW macro, a self-contained range-reduced `vexp_f32m1` (k=round(x*log2e), split-ln2 r, degree-5 Horner Q, 2^k bit reconstruction, finite clamp, NaN re-injection), a `vstore_as` float/f16-narrowing store, a three-pass `log_softmax_fwd_row` (vle32 + vfredmax seed reduction; vfsub.vf + vexp + vfredusum seed reduction; vfsub.vf(x-mmax-log(sum)) + vse32/vse16), an eligibility trait, and an `if constexpr` fast-path dispatch for contiguous float32 log_softmax_fwd at temperature==1.0 with length==nullptr; the existing scalar loops and softmax_fwd path are unchanged. CMakeLists.txt gains a riscv64-gated check_cxx_compiler_flag block appending `-march=rv64gcv_zfhmin_zvfhmin` (fallback `-march=rv64gcv`) to CMAKE_C_FLAGS/CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS. No other files, no reformatting.
